title: Live files B: infrastructure and policy for the edit overlay (Front Door write, supervisor deny)
description:
Contract: docs/LIVE_FILES_PROTOCOL.md (revision 2) sections 12.8, 15 (B), 3 (L30, L37). Independent of the other parts; deploy before anything writes an overlay object. Gherkin first (features/computer_file_live.feature, scenarios "The owner roles cannot write or delete overlay objects" and "The Front Door writes the overlay with conditional puts" are shared with A3).

Why infrastructure is needed (owner decision: files are edited with the computer off, through an overlay in the snapshot bucket): the Front Door role has only s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket on the snapshot prefix (infra/lib/control-plane-stack.ts around lines 414-427), and the supervisor role may PutObject on its whole computer prefix.

Files:
- infra/lib/control-plane-stack.ts: next to ReadComputerSnapshots add the Front Door statement Sid WriteComputerEditOverlay, Effect Allow, Actions s3:PutObject and s3:DeleteObject, Resource arn:aws:s3:::SNAPSHOT_BUCKET/tenants/*/computers/*/overlay/* . Do not grant s3:DeleteObjectVersion.
- conversation/src/gateway/supervisor-role-policy.json: keep SnapshotObjects (Allow) and add Sid OverlayIsWrittenByTheFrontDoorOnly, Effect Deny, Actions s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject, s3:DeleteObjectVersion, s3:PutObjectTagging, s3:AbortMultipartUpload, Resource {{snapshotBucketArn}}/tenants/${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant}/computers/${aws:PrincipalTag/computer}/overlay/* .
- infra/lib/owner-role-policy.ts: pass the statement Effect through (supervisorRolePolicyStatements) so Deny is deployed.
- conversation/features-support/iam-policy-evaluator.ts: the statement type is Effect "Allow" only today; learn Deny (a matching deny overrides any allow).
- features/owner_role_policy.feature and features/computer_owner_policy_coverage.feature: rows for overlay/index.json and overlay/blobs/<hash>: per-turn role denied Get, Put and Delete; supervisor role allowed Get, denied Put, Delete, DeleteObjectVersion; the supervisor still allowed Put on snapshot.tar.gz; denied on another computer's overlay.
- infra/test/computer-owner-stack.test.ts: assertions for the Front Door statement (only overlay/*), the supervisor deny, no DeleteObjectVersion.
- Only if the owner approves Q-O3: infra/lib/snapshot-stack.ts noncurrentVersionExpiration 30 days. Otherwise leave and say so in a comment on this ticket.

Acceptance: cd infra && npm test; cd conversation && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:features (the existing supervisor role scenarios stay green; 'allows only Get, Put and Abort on its own prefix' remains true for everything except overlay/).

Dependencies: none. Blocks A2 and C2 reaching development (merge first in the deploy order).

Rules: no emojis, no line comments. AWS resources only through CDK. Do not read or write project/.


REVISION 3 (owner decision O5: delete, rename and new folders are required in Phase 3, also while the computer is off; contract sections 3 L48 to L66, 5.2, 5.5, 7.8, 8.1):
- The lifecycle rule is part of this ticket, not optional (owner decision O6): infra/lib/snapshot-stack.ts, noncurrentVersionExpiration of 30 days on the bucket, with a CDK assertion in infra/test. Plain explanation for the PR description: the bucket is versioned, so S3 keeps every overwritten object as a hidden older version; today every publish overwrites the whole pack, so those versions are whole-workspace snapshots, not per-file history, and they are never expired; it is a storage cost and a recovery window, not a product feature. The rule does not touch current objects.
- LocalWorkerRole is left as it is (owner decision O7).
- The Front Door statement WriteComputerEditOverlay (PutObject, DeleteObject on overlay/*) also covers the deletes the clear performs.
